cross_modal_consistency.dimension_interpretation: Across the four native patient geometries, the candidate-pair boundary between K3_C0001_M_K3_C0002 and K3_C0003 is not coherently represented. The set's own structural screen shows a single-cluster-dominated leading eigengap (candidate_k=1) with low within-set cohesion (mean_within_affinity 0.394), and no feasible internal subdivision signal is available to support a split. With membership broadly unsupported, the boundary to the only neighboring unit unresolved, and no supported structural revision available, the candidate lacks defensible discovery-stage value.
